title: GMGSI global geostationary mosaic, hourly (Icechunk)
description:
NOAA Global Mosaic of Geostationary Satellite Imagery (GMGSI), a composite of GOES, Meteosat and Himawari imagery, published as an Icechunk 2.x repository at `gmgsi_v3.icechunk` on source.coop. Confirmed reachable (200 on the `repo` object, which is binary -- an Icechunk config/snapshot object, not a plain Zarr file) with CORS enabled (`access-control-allow-origin: *`). Note: an earlier probe path for this fixture (`bkr/gmgi/gmgsi.zarr/zarr.json`, without the `_v3.icechunk` suffix and as plain Zarr) 404s -- that path does not exist; the real store is the Icechunk repo at the URL below, which does. bbox is estimated for a global geostationary composite.

CORRECTION (browser run, 2026-11): the arrays WERE inspected, by opening the repository with `icechunk-js` 0.6.1 in node, which reads this 2.x layout without trouble (spec version 2). The blocker is not the client: this store carries `latitude` and `longitude` as **2-D** arrays of [y, x] = [3000, 5000] float32, the way a curvilinear or swath grid is written, with no affine transform and no grid-mapping variable. The browser derives a transform only from 1-D coordinate arrays (see cbofs-ssh, which is refused for the same reason), so there is nothing here it can place on the map.

License unknown; declared "proprietary" with a via link.

Expected browser outcome: refused with the no-spatial-reference notice -- 2-D (non-1-D) spatial coordinates, which this browser's Zarr map support does not handle.
